name: edwinwright-plugins
description: Claude plugins for software delivery, engineering practice, and knowledge work: an end-to-end SDLC pipeline, personal coding conventions, and note and document authoring for an Obsidian vault.

plugins.name: delivery-design
plugins.description: End-to-end SDLC delivery pipeline on three routes: requirements discovery, product definition, domain modelling, request triage, backlog refinement, technical design, delivery planning, work breakdown, publishing to Linear/GitHub, acceptance review, and decision records.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Personal engineering conventions: the judgement rules for TypeScript, React, and Next.js that a linter cannot enforce, plus the standard setup a new project gets.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Note and document authoring for an Obsidian vault: the source of truth for document shape and house style, plus workflows for writing and refactoring notes, synthesising conversations, and turning processes into checklists, runbooks, and playbooks.
